doc.title: Denny Zeitlin interviewed by Monk Rowe, San Francisco, California, August 8, 2002

title: Decade of multi-keyboard electronic music
summary: He built a huge rig of Moog and other synths from about 1967 to 1978, left Columbia, and then returned to acoustic piano.
